page4_s1.raw_text: This policy is written on a continuous basis. Each period of one (1) year, ending on the annual anniversary date of this policy, constitutes a separate policy period. 1. The Policy Term on this Declarations began at 12:01 Standard Time at the described location for twelve (12) months from 04/23/2006 and for successive twelve (12) month Policy Terms as stated below. 2. This policy may be continued by payment of the required premium for the next Policy Term. The premium must be paid to "us" as specified in "our" premium notice. 3. Under the laws of this state, "we" may be entitled not to renew this policy under some circumstances. 4. If any of the forms attached to "your" policy are revised, "we" will furnish "you" with a copy of the revised form at renewal time.
